capabilities: publish vault notes and blog posts to a mixa.site site
connect the vault to a site using a secret token
republish changes with a one-click publish button
extras: Site creation, themes and customization happen in the mixa.site dashboard; the plugin only handles publishing from Obsidian. Docs, roadmap, Discord and email support are linked.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to publish notes as a public website with themes, SEO and a custom domain.
summary: Publishing plugin that sends notes and blog posts to a mixa.site website with one click.
